name: Fire Extinguisher
imageAlt: Fire Extinguisher in-game icon from Scrap Mechanic

recipes.ingredients: 1 Metal Block Level 1 10 Ice Block 5 Chemicals

sections.heading: What Fire Extinguisher Is
paragraphs: Carry it when working around active fires. It is consumed through use, so keep a reserve instead of treating the first stack as permanent equipment.

sections.heading: Unlocking and Crafting
paragraphs: The quest reward unlocks the schematic or item state; it does not mean a finished placeable part is silently added every time. Use the current production method below after the unlock appears.
bullets: Craftbot: 1 Metal Block Level 1 10 Ice Block 5 Chemicals (5 sec) → 10 Fire Extinguisher Hideout: 1 Tomato Crate (Not listed) → 50 Fire Extinguisher

sections.heading: Before You Build Around It
bullets: Confirm the reward has registered in the quest log or customization interface.
Use the published footprint and physical properties when clearance, weight, or collision matters.
Prototype the part on a temporary surface before making it difficult to remove.

seo.title: Scrap Mechanic Fire Extinguisher - Uses and Guide
seo.description: In Scrap Mechanic, use to put out fires. Check its 1.0 unlock, recipe, properties, and related quest. Verify it in-game. Verify the current role in-game.
